faqs.question: Is this the Columbia County school calendar for Florida?
faqs.answer: Yes. These dates are for Columbia County School District in Florida, including Columbia High School in Lake City and Fort White High School. They are not calendars for Columbia-named districts in other states.

faqs.question: Which Columbia school years are available?
faqs.answer: The verified 2026-2027 district calendar is available. Calendars for 2027-2028, 2028-2029 and 2029-2030 have not been verified or added; check the district’s school-calendar page for later releases.

hero.mobileDescription: Columbia County School District classes begin Aug 10 and end May 26 for most students. Seniors at Columbia High and Fort White High finish May 14. Four dates are reserved for possible weather make-up.
hero.desktopDescription: Columbia County School District students begin classes August 10, 2026. Most students finish May 26, 2027; Columbia High and Fort White High seniors finish May 14. Spring break runs March 22–26, and four scheduled days off are reserved for possible weather make-up.

editorialSummary.heading: Breaks, weather make-up days and senior dates
paragraphs: Thanksgiving week is scheduled without classes from November 23–27, 2026, but November 23–24 are reserved for possible weather make-up. November 25 is a system closure, November 26 is Thanksgiving, and November 27 is a district holiday. The other possible make-up dates are February 15 and April 19, 2027.

Winter break runs from December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. January 5 is a teacher workday and student holiday, so students return January 6. Another teacher workday/student holiday falls on March 19, just before spring break on March 22–26. Classes are scheduled to resume March 29. The calendar's 'Instructional Virtual' wording does not designate these teacher workdays as online class days for students.

Seniors at Columbia High School in Lake City and Fort White High School in Fort White finish May 14, 2027. Regular classes for other students end May 26. Fort White High's baccalaureate is May 20 and graduation is May 21; Columbia High's ceremonies are May 27 and 28. The district calendar does not provide ceremony times.

Only September 23, 2026, and February 24, 2027, are marked as student early-release days. The district calendar does not list dismissal times, and neither December 18 nor May 26 is marked as a half day. Check your child's school for pickup and bus details.

about.dataSource: The supplied scanned one-page PDF matches the current official file by SHA-256. Its School Board APPROVED stamp reads January 27, 2026. The district page identifies this as the 26-27 calendar. The entire image was visually inspected because the PDF contains no extractable text; scanner metadata was not used as the approval date.
about.processing: Transcribed the date table and approval stamp from the rendered page. Only September 23 and February 24 explicitly say Student Early Release Day. October 12, January 5 and March 19 explicitly remain student holidays despite the teacher-workday parenthetical Instructional Virtual; no student remote-instruction event is inferred. November 23-24, February 15 and April 19 are scheduled student-free weather reserves with separate conditional flags and IDs. No reserve priority or activation was found. November 25 and 27 explicitly close the system; Thanksgiving is a separate legal holiday, and the continuous Thanksgiving-week summary is derived with a null guaranteed days-off count. Holiday Break - System Closed is the printed continuous December 21-January 4 range; January 5 remains a separate student holiday and January 6 is the explicit return. March 16 grading end does not close March 17-18; the March 19 workday joins March 22-26 spring break and weekends, with a derived March 29 return. The May 14 senior endpoint is scoped to CHS/FWHS; May 26 is the non-senior regular endpoint without early release. Four school ceremonies, including May 27-28 after classes end, remain non-attendance milestones. No early dismissal or grading-period endpoint is invented for May 26. The regular non-senior baseline has 208 weekdays minus 26 confirmed student-free weekdays and four conditional reserve weekdays, yielding 178 scheduled attendance weekdays. This is a calculation, not a printed annual student total. The 180/190/196-day paraprofessional labels describe staff contracts and do not prove student attendance totals. Fiscal, personnel, orientation, FTE, staff workweek and post-planning dates are omitted. Summer camp/recovery endpoints are explained only as separate-program FAQ guidance, without assuming daily attendance or the staff four-day week applies to students.

faqs.question: When does school start in Columbia County, FL, for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of classes is Monday, August 10, 2026, on the Columbia County School District calendar.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Columbia County, FL, in 2027?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, May 26, 2027, is the last regular class day for most students. Seniors at Columbia High School and Fort White High School have an earlier last day on May 14.

faqs.question: When is spring break for Columbia County schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 22–26, 2027, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, March 29. Friday, March 19 is a separate teacher workday and student holiday, giving students March 19–28 off when the weekends are included.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do classes resume in January?
faqs.answer: The school system closes for winter break from December 21, 2026 through January 4, 2027. January 5 is a teacher workday and student holiday. Classes resume Wednesday, January 6, when the second semester begins.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Columbia County schools?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled off November 23–27, 2026, with a regular return on Monday, November 30. However, November 23–24 are reserved for possible weather make-up. November 25 is a system closure, November 26 is Thanksgiving, and November 27 is a district holiday.

faqs.question: Does Columbia County School District have a fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The approved 2026–2027 calendar does not list a separate multi-day fall break. Students have a professional-development holiday on September 28 and a teacher workday/student holiday on October 12. Thanksgiving week is scheduled November 23–27, although November 23–24 may be used for weather make-up.

faqs.question: What are the 2026–2027 weather make-up dates?
faqs.answer: The four reserved dates are November 23–24, 2026, February 15, 2027 and April 19, 2027. They are scheduled without regular student classes but may become attendance days if the district uses them for weather make-up. The approved calendar does not specify an order for using these dates.

faqs.question: Is there school on November 23–24, 2026?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled off both days, but November 23 and 24 are reserved for possible weather make-up. Either date could become a school day if the district activates it. November 25–27 are separate holidays or closures.

faqs.question: When are Columbia County student early-release days?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists two student early-release dates: September 23, 2026, and February 24, 2027. Both fall on Wednesdays. Students attend classes but leave early on these dates.

faqs.question: What time does school dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: Dismissal times are not included in the district's annual calendar. Check your child's school for its early-release time, pickup arrangements and bus schedule. Do not assume that an older school year's dismissal time still applies.

faqs.question: What time do Columbia County schools start and dismiss each day?
faqs.answer: The district's 2026–2027 calendar lists school dates but not daily bell schedules. Start and dismissal times may differ by school. Check your child's school for current hours and transportation information.

faqs.question: When is the last school day for Columbia High and Fort White High seniors?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 14, 2027, is the last day for graduating seniors at both Columbia High School and Fort White High School. Other students continue on the regular district calendar through May 26. Seniors should check with their school for exam, rehearsal and checkout instructions.

faqs.question: When is Columbia High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Columbia High School graduation is Friday, May 28, 2027. Its baccalaureate is Thursday, May 27. Both dates fall after the district's May 26 last regular class day. The annual calendar does not list ceremony times or venues.

faqs.question: When is Fort White High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Fort White High School graduation is Friday, May 21, 2027. Its baccalaureate is Thursday, May 20. Check the school for ceremony times, locations and guest arrangements.

faqs.question: When are the 2027 baccalaureate ceremonies?
faqs.answer: Fort White High School's baccalaureate is Thursday, May 20, 2027, and Columbia High School's is Thursday, May 27. These are separate from the graduation ceremonies on May 21 and May 28. The district calendar does not provide ceremony times.

faqs.question: Is there school on February 15, 2027?
faqs.answer: February 15 falls on Presidents Day, but the district calendar labels it as a student holiday and professional-development day reserved for possible weather make-up. Students are scheduled off unless the district activates the date for classes.

faqs.question: Is there school on April 19, 2027?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled off April 19 for professional development, but the date is also reserved for possible weather make-up. If the district does not activate it, classes resume Tuesday, April 20.

faqs.question: Is there school on March 19, 2027?
faqs.answer: No student classes are scheduled for Friday, March 19. It is a teacher workday and student holiday immediately before the March 22–26 spring break. The calendar does not identify it as a student remote-learning day.

faqs.question: Does 'Instructional Virtual' mean students must attend online classes?
faqs.answer: No student online classes are assigned by the annual calendar for these dates. October 12, 2026, January 5 and March 19, 2027 are listed as teacher workdays and student holidays, with 'Instructional Virtual' in parentheses. Follow any separate school instructions if the schedule changes.

faqs.question: Is December 18, 2026 an early-release day?
faqs.answer: December 18 is the last day before the holiday break and the end of the first semester. The district calendar does not mark it as an early-release or half day. The system-closed holiday break begins December 21.

faqs.question: Is May 26, 2027 a half day?
faqs.answer: May 26 is the last regular day of classes for most students, but the district calendar does not label it as a half day or early-release day. Check your school for any separate dismissal instructions.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays and professional-development days are student holidays in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled off September 28 and October 12, 2026, and January 5, February 15, March 19 and April 19, 2027. September 28, February 15 and April 19 are professional-development days; the other three are teacher workdays. February 15 and April 19 may become school days if used for weather make-up.

faqs.question: Do students have school on September 28, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 28 is a professional-development day and student holiday. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, September 29. This is separate from the September 23 early-release day.

faqs.question: Do students have school on October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12 is a teacher workday and student holiday. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, October 13. The October 9 end of the first grading period does not create an additional student holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day, September 7, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Columbia County students are off Monday, September 7 for Labor Day. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: Are Columbia County schools open on Veterans Day, November 11, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11 is a legal holiday for students and personnel. It is a full student holiday, not an early-release day.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, January 18, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18 is a legal holiday for students and personnel. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Is this the districtwide calendar or a school-specific calendar?
faqs.answer: This is the regular 2026–2027 calendar for Columbia County School District in Florida. Individual schools may have additional events or different daily bell schedules. The district specifically lists an earlier May 14 last day for seniors at Columbia High and Fort White High.

faqs.question: Where can families check report cards and progress reports?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists grading-period end dates, including October 9, December 18 and March 16, but not report-card or interim-report release dates. Check the district's Focus Parent Portal or school notices for reporting information.

faqs.question: How many school days are scheduled for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Based on the published calendar, the regular non-senior schedule has 178 calculated attendance weekdays: 208 weekdays minus 26 confirmed no-class weekdays and four possible weather make-up dates. This is not an official student-day total published by the district. The count may change if make-up dates are used.

faqs.question: When do summer reading camp and secondary credit recovery run?
faqs.answer: Both programs are listed as starting June 7, 2027, and ending June 24, 2027. They are separate from the regular school year. The district calendar does not specify their daily schedules, locations, hours or eligibility. Contact the school for program details.

faqs.question: Where can I find the approved 2026–2027 school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF link on this page or visit Columbia County School District's 26-27 School Calendar page. The PDF carries a School Board approval stamp dated January 27, 2026. Check district and individual school notices for any later schedule changes.
